name: JobBridge
title: AI Resume Analyzer and Job Matcher
description: JobBridge is an AI-powered platform that analyzes resumes, matches candidates with suitable jobs, and identifies skill gaps using the Gemini API.
problem: Students often struggle to understand whether their resume matches job requirements and what skills they need to improve.
solution: JobBridge uses Gemini AI to analyze resumes, compare them with job descriptions, and provide personalized recommendations.
